description: Propose a change to the spec when the code has to differ from it (for example a field the spec missed). This stages the proposal; it does NOT edit the spec. The review screen for staged proposals is coming, so until it ships the owner will not see it in the app: also list it in your final summary. While building, always use this instead of the update_* tools. Give the entity, the content fields you want changed with their new values (only that entity's content fields are accepted: not status, ids, codes, assignment or sprint) and a short rationale; add evidence (a file path, test name or error) if you have it. An identical pending proposal is returned instead of duplicated; at most 10 per minute and 50 pending per project.

criterionId.description: Optional criterion you were building when you found this

entityId.description: UUID of the entity to change

evidence.description: Optional supporting detail: file path, test name, error text (max 2000 chars)

fields.description: Content field names mapped to the new values you propose (max 20). Allowed by entity: feature (name, description, priority, category, complexity, effort, business_value); user_story (title, description, i_want_to, so_that, user_role, priority, estimated_effort); acceptance_criterion (title, description, given_condition, when_action, then_outcome, scenario_category); page (name, description, path, page_type, layout_intent, api_endpoints, ui_states, state_requirements, priority); persona (name, tagline, user_role, narrative, avatar_description, demographics, psychographics, goals_and_needs, pain_points, product_specific, behavioral_patterns, communication_preferences, user_journey).

rationale.description: Why the spec should change (1-2000 chars)

name: vibemap_propose_spec_change
